clipping_policy: full stroke must fit original second-system viewport
collision_policy: all nonzero alpha pixels; zero extender/fixed and extender/lyric and extender/extender contacts; positive ink-center clearance; fail closed, never relayout old layers
geometry: New horizontal 2px strokes; source bbox x and width retained; y = floor((top+bottom-1)/2), plus frozen GT14A whole-row dy. No source raster pixels copied. This is typeset geometry, not source-ink ownership.
scope: Only the three owner-reclassified extenders. Other visible row continuation strokes are not inferred or silently generated. 5747 maps to existing upper 하, no extra glyph.
source_row_assignment: source-only original review crop vertical position; rows retain 45px separation
unchanged_music: Reuse exact GT14A combined alpha and cached music; add three masks only
